fb9b381ab0082440.why:
Read against what it implements: "a value or keyword that a rule of the list already changed … the rule’s text, and that the value shown includes it". The new layout keeps the same pieces and only reorders them:
- Label: "<value> · granted by" (e.g. "A 10 · granted by", "RAPID FIRE 1 · granted by").
- Title: the granting names from w.from/s.from, joined with " + " (e.g. "Berzerker Glaive + Relentless Rage").
- Per source, from grantSource: its stored who/tag line or rule source, its stored text and table. The name is repeated as a heading only when there are several sources.
- The unchanged note: "Already in the value/keywords shown (as New Recruit and BSData list it/them)". This is still backed by bsdata.json (grants compared both ways) and nr.json (values and keywords compared cell by cell) with 0 failures.
- The keyword’s own rule (ruleFor), last.
No condition, scope or conclusion is added, and nothing is left out. The marks the popup names are the ones I spot-checked in the previous review, all granted by their named rule’s text. The rest is display only.
